This is my maize plot, and maize needs good soil to give a proper harvest. I will buy some DAP and urea from the cooperative — not the full package they tell us, because money is tight, but enough to help the crop. I keep the cattle manure from our kraal for this plot too, since I have been farming this land for many years and I know manure keeps it strong. I will plant the seed I saved from last year, and my daughters and I will do most of the work ourselves, hiring a few hands only for the weeding when the rains come hard.
